nodes.name: FINAL-REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Final aggregated report for the UX habit-loop judging mission (2026-06-12), summarizing scorecard results across 5 judge personas over multiple rounds, listing all shipped fixes, documenting why unanimous 5/5 scores are structurally unreachable in-session, and cataloguing remaining UX residuals.

nodes.name: judge-1-novice.md
nodes.summary: UX evaluation verdict from the perspective of a complete novice user, scoring Waggle OS across 5 criteria (first-session clarity, 'it knows me' feeling, visible agent growth, desire to return, absence of friction) with per-criterion reasoning and concrete complaints.

nodes.name: judge-2-casual-professional.md
nodes.summary: UX evaluation verdict from the perspective of a casual non-technical professional, scoring Waggle OS across 5 habit-loop criteria with detailed per-criterion reasoning and actionable complaints about onboarding friction and memory visibility.

nodes.name: judge-3-power-user.md
nodes.summary: Detailed UX evaluation verdict from a non-developer power user, providing the most thorough per-criterion analysis (171 lines) including power-user spot checks and extensive concrete complaints about agent growth visibility and onboarding friction.

nodes.name: judge-4-junior-developer.md
nodes.summary: UX evaluation verdict from a junior developer persona, scoring Waggle OS on 5 habit-loop criteria with notable positive marks for first-session clarity, 'knows me' feeling, and desire to return, while flagging friction in absence-of-friction and agent growth visibility.

nodes.name: judge-5-senior-skeptic.md
nodes.summary: UX evaluation from a senior engineer / professional skeptic persona, applying the most critical standards across 5 habit-loop criteria with numbered, actionable complaints focused on observable agent growth and friction elimination.

nodes.name: round1-fixes.md
nodes.summary: Consolidated mapping of Round 1 judge complaints to concrete code fixes applied between judging rounds, serving as the actionable bridge between UX feedback and implementation.
